deadline.value: Fall 2027 entry: international applicants must submit by March 1 for visa timing. The domestic fall deadline is March 15, with assistantship priority to files submitted by February 15.
deadline.quote: International applicants must submit by March 1 due to visa processing timeline.

also.quote: For Fall semester: March 15, with priority consideration given to completed applications submitted by February 15.

gre_general.value: The physics page says the GRE is being waived for PhD applicants at this time, although it also recommends the GRE. Confirm with the department before applying.
gre_general.quote: At this time, the GRE is being waived for both M.A. and Ph.D. applicants

gre_subject.value: The Physics Subject GRE is recommended and gives an edge in admission, but the same page says the GRE is being waived for PhD applicants at this time.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE is not required, but recommended for both the General and Physics Subject exams for Ph.D. applicants

toefl_min.value: The physics page requires TOEFL iBT 80 (or PBT 550) for applicants from non-English-speaking countries.
toefl_min.quote: The TOEFL exam is required for students from non-English speaking countries: PBT (550) or iBT (80)

supervisor.value: The physics pages checked do not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Assistantships are limited, typically 3 to 6 for each entering class, so funding is not guaranteed for every student.
funding.quote: We offer a variable number (typically 3-6) of graduate assistantships to Ph.D. and occasionally to masters students in each year’s entering class

entry_route.value: The physics pages checked do not say whether a master's degree is needed.

notes: Department page and graduate-college page both state GRE rules, and they conflict (recommended versus waived at this time). Both are quoted; confirm with the department. The separate Science Education: Physics PhD is not included.
name: Physics (Ph.D.)
